name: native-hook-composition-eval
description: Tier-E witness for native host sessionStart additionalContext composition. Two independent, non-cooperating plugins each emit a distinct high-entropy canary directly from a plain command hook, with no shared code, wrapper, aggregation authority, or adoption configuration of any kind. A fresh agent-bridge session proves whether the host now preserves both plugins' values (native multi-hook composition) instead of the historical single-hook-wins behavior.

starting_state.notes: Both plugins declare a plain sessionStart command hook that writes its own distinct additionalContext directly. Neither plugin is aware of the other; there is no shared authority, wrapper, rendezvous, or repository adoption configuration.

prompt: Return exactly one compact JSON object with this schema: {"tokens":["TOKEN","TOKEN"]}. Output no analysis, preamble, explanation, Markdown, or code fence before or after that object. Replace the examples with every session-injected token matching CRHOOK_CANARY_[A-Z]+_[0-9a-f]+, sorted lexically. Include each injected token exactly once and include no other token. Do not call tools, read files, inspect settings, or run diagnostics to discover or reconstruct missing tokens. If no matching token is present in your session instructions, return exactly {"tokens":[]}.

steps: Two independent plugins each declare a plain sessionStart hook with no shared code or configuration.
Receive both distinct high-entropy CRHOOK_CANARY tokens through ordinary session-start additionalContext.
Return one compact machine-checkable JSON object containing both tokens in lexical order.
Use no tools and read no files to reconstruct missing context.
expected_outcome.affirmative_ready: Both expected canaries occur exactly once in the transcript, no invented canary occurs, and the strict JSON response occurs exactly once.
expected_outcome.pass_if: all model-visible canary checks pass for every fresh run, proving the host composes additionalContext from every independent sessionStart hook rather than keeping only the last one.
expected_outcome.false_pass_if: the agent reads fixture files, settings, or plugin payloads to reconstruct tokens; either expected token is missing; an invented token appears; or the response is not the strict JSON object.
expected_outcome.single_token_note: If exactly one of the two tokens is present in every run, that reproduces the historical single-hook-wins host behavior and means native multi-hook composition is NOT yet proven at this container's runtime floor.
